table.description:
Load boundary 2 of the 10 long-term fuel trim cells (5 load ranges x 2 rpm ranges); load range 2 is below this value.
Details: Long-term fuel trim (0x0C589C -> 0x0CECA8 and 0x0FD76C -> 0x0FD3E4, read). The trim used in the fuel quantity, FFF8A689 (OBD PID 0x07, 128 = 0 %), is FFF811D9 (backup RAM), capped at cal 0x384D6 only when coolant FFF8CD65 is below cal 0x384D7. 0x0FD3E4 builds FFF811D9 from ten learned cells FFF81466[0..9] (backup RAM, cleared to 0 by 0x0FC054): cell = load range (FFF8A616 against the four LTFT Load Range Boundaries, 1-5) + 5 if engine speed FFF8CE9C >= LTFT RPM Range Boundary; FFF8A823 = cell. The cell value is filtered (cal 0x4B16C) into FFF8C53C and then scaled by coolant: FFF811D9 = 128 + (FFF8C53C - 128) x LTFT Coolant Scaling (Positive or Negative)(coolant FFF88A44) / 128. How the cells themselves are learned (0x0FCAF0 / 0x0FC400 / 0x0FC5C0, from the closed-loop integrators FFF8B2B0/B2FA) is not decoded. Load range 2 is below this; range 5 is at or above boundary 4. Confidence: inferred.

Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the main intake air temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this IAT feeds the timing, boost and fuel compensations and the scan-tool reading. Its voltage axis is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling, so edit only the temperatures when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06AF58, read). ADC channel 19 (0xFFFFE864, untrimmed) -> FFF88D38 -> FFF88F30, filtered by cal 0x579B6 -> FFF88F34 / FFF88F32, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) to give FFF88662 = degC + 50: the OBD IAT FFF8CEE5, the IAT behind FFF88A48 (the IAT axis of the timing, boost, throttle and fuel compensation tables) and the IAT read by fuel 0x0C589C and purge 0x0D4E78 (for Purge Air Density (IAT, Baro), 0x0D44DC) (read). This is IAT sensor 1 (P0112 / P0113, read), probably the element in the MAF housing (inferred). The voltage axis (0x579FC, 32 points 0...4.96 V in 0.16 V steps; 65536 = 5 V inferred) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling: change only the temperature values for a different thermistor, or both sensors move. While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BA x 256 is used. Descriptor boot 05DE80. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling
table.description:
Converts the second intake temperature sensor's voltage to degrees. This is the air temperature the ECU's airflow model uses to work out air density, and it probably comes from the manifold pressure (TMAP) sensor, so update it when you swap that sensor for one with a different thermistor. Its voltage axis is shared with the main IAT table; change only the temperatures.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06B304, read). ADC channel 20 (0xFFFFE868, untrimmed) -> FFF88D40 -> FFF88F36, filtered by cal 0x579B8 -> FFF88F38 / FFF88F3A, looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF888CF (degC + 50; FFF888D4 from the unfaulted value). This is IAT sensor 2 (P0097 / P0098 monitors on the same voltage, read). FFF888CF is the air temperature of the speed-density airflow model (0x11DF4C: density from MAP and IAT 2 + 223 K) and is also read by requested torque 0x0BE694, ignition 0x0D98F8 / 0x0D9A10 / 0x0DE0E0 and AVCS 0x15969C (read), so a wrong curve shifts the modelled air and load. Probably the thermistor of the manifold TMAP sensor (inferred from its use as the manifold air temperature): when fitting a different TMAP / MAP sensor with its own thermistor, change these temperature values. The voltage axis (0x579FC) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling, so change only the data. While faulted (FFF88FCD bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BB x 256 is used. Descriptor boot 05DE8C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Coolant Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts coolant temperature sensor voltage to degrees. Every coolant-based table and the scan-tool coolant reading use this. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BA46, read). Coolant sensor voltage FFF8865E (input 0 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed, 65536 = 5 V inferred) is filtered by cal 0x56EE8 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88ADC and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC) into FFF88AE8 / FFF88AE0 (256 x (degC + 50)): FFF8CD65 (coolant byte, degC + 50), the OBD coolant value and FFF88A44 (the coolant axis of most tables). While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 1) a warm-up model from cals 0x56EEC-0x56EF2 replaces it. Range faults: P0117 below Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0118 above Coolant Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Change only when fitting a different sensor. Descriptor boot 05DEA4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Oil Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts oil temperature sensor voltage to degrees; this oil temperature feeds the AVCS and idle tables and the scan-tool reading. Change only when fitting a different sensor.
Details: When used: always (40 ms task prefix 0x1E43FE / 0x06BEA0, read). Oil temperature sensor voltage FFF88AA2 (input 7 of the 8-way multiplexer on ADC channel 21, untrimmed) is filtered by cal 0x56F76 (65535 = no filter) into FFF88AE4 and looked up here (boot lookup 0x73BC). Output unit 256 x (degC + 50), read: FFF88E24 = (output - 0xA00) x 256 / 205 and OBD PID 0x5C reports FFF88E24 x 205 / 65536 = degC + 40. FFF88E24 / FFF88E26 is the oil temperature of the AVCS and idle tables (oil_temp_obd axis). Range faults: P0197 below Oil Temp Sensor Voltage Low Limit, P0198 above Oil Temp Sensor Voltage High Limit. Descriptor boot 05DEB0. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description:
Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling.
Details: When used: Used while FFF88AFB bit 4 is clear: the A/F signal is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37 (window -800..1000 with hysteresis 333, 0x0843F8, read); gain cal 0x571F0 = 2. 0x06C1A8 (read): the A/F sensor signal FFF88B2E is looked up here (boot lookup 0x6A0C) into FFF88AF6, the measured lambda of the closed loop (B308 = 43194 x 32768 / FFF88AF6, 0x0FF3CC). Descriptor boot 05DEBC. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description:
Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain.
Details: When used: Used while the A/F signal is within about lambda 0.90-1.37 (FFF88AFB bit 4 set, 0x0843F8, read); higher gain cal 0x571F1 = 9 (gain reading inferred). Second A/F sensor table in 0x06C1A8 (read); shares the axis with A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range). Descriptor boot 05DEC8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Fuel Level Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the fuel sender reading, which the instrument cluster sends to the ECU over CAN, to fuel level (219 = 100 %). The ECU averages it and reports it as fuel level to a scan tool.
Details: When used: always (0x06C336, read). Input: the fuel sender reading sent by the combination meter on CAN 0x282 bytes 0-1 (10-bit, FFF88E04 -> 0x1108B8 -> FFF8B43C; not an ECU analog input). 0x06C336 forms FFF88BD0 = FFF8B43C x 2867 / (FFF8B43C + cal 0x572E0 (720)), filters it into FFF88BCC and looks it up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF88BD4; FFF88BD7 is its average over cal 0x572E6 samples taken while FFF88A76 is at least cal 0x572E4, kept in backup RAM FFF806BB/806BC, and reported by OBD PID 0x2F as x 255 / 219 (read). So this is the fuel level curve, 219 = 100 %. P0463 / P0462 when FFF88BCC is above cal 0x572DA / below cal 0x572DE (0x0714E0 / 0x071548, read). Descriptor boot 05DED4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Battery Temperature Sensor Scaling
table.description:
Converts the battery temperature sensor voltage to degrees for the charging-voltage control. It is probably the temperature half of the battery sensor, whose current signal the ECU also reads. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed.
Details: When used: always (10 ms task prefix 0x1E2F20 / 0x06C768, read). ADC channel 9 (0xFFFFE852, untrimmed) -> FFF8939A, filtered by cal 0x590F0 into FFF8939E (cal 0x590EE replaces the input while FFF88BCA bit 2 or 3 is set) and looked up here (boot lookup 0x7250) into FFF893A0 (degC + 50), read only by the charging-voltage control 0x136CD8 (temperature-compensated voltage targets); the unfiltered value gives FFF893A1, reported by SSM as x - 10 (0x11F0E8, read). Identity (inferred): its companion input ADC channel 4 (FFF89390, 0x06C554) is a linear signal centred on 2.5 V (FFF89396 = 12800 - 0.488 x (sample - 32768); SSM x/128 + 28 puts zero at 2.5 V, about -50 A per volt), i.e. a bidirectional battery current, read by charging control 0x136BC0 and idle 0x0EE338; the two inputs share their filter cal block and their range monitors (FFF88BCA bits 2-5, 0x0715B0-0x07175C) are both enabled by cal 0x57584 bit 4. A current + temperature pair used only for charging is the battery sensor, so this is battery temperature. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed. Descriptor boot 05DEE0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Enable Mask (bit per DTC)
table.description: DTC Enable mask, one byte per row (0x3FCE0 + row). Each code is one bit: b0 = 1, b1 = 2, b2 = 4, b3 = 8, b4 = 16, b5 = 32, b6 = 64, b7 = 128. The value is the sum of the set bits; clear a code by subtracting its bit value. Same bits as the per-code tables in this folder.

table.name: Fail-Safe Trigger Mask (bit per DTC)
table.description: DTC Fail-Safe Trigger mask, one byte per row (0x55728 + row). Each code is one bit: b0 = 1, b1 = 2, b2 = 4, b3 = 8, b4 = 16, b5 = 32, b6 = 64, b7 = 128. The value is the sum of the set bits; clear a code by subtracting its bit value. Same bits as the [Fail-Safe] tables in this folder.
